title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor
plain: The ABS computer has a problem with the left front wheel speed sensor. Some makers, GM especially, use C0 numbers with their own meanings, so confirm with a make-specific lookup.
symptoms: ABS, traction control or stability light on
ABS may not work on slippery roads
Cruise control or speedometer may act up on some vehicles

causes.name: Damaged or dirty wheel speed sensor
Broken or chafed sensor wire near the wheel
Rusted, cracked or debris-covered tone ring
Worn wheel bearing with excess play

checks: Look at the left front sensor wire for damage from road debris or suspension movement
Compare all four wheel speeds in live data while driving slowly
Clean rust or debris off the sensor tip and tone ring
fix: Usually a new wheel speed sensor or wiring repair; sometimes a wheel bearing with a built-in tone ring.

title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor
plain: The stability control system has a problem with the sensor that measures which way and how far the steering wheel is turned. Some makers, GM especially, use C0 numbers with their own meanings, so confirm with a make-specific lookup.
symptoms: Stability control or traction control light on
Stability control may be turned off
Steering assist features may not work

causes.name: Steering angle sensor not calibrated after an alignment or steering repair
Worn clock spring or wiring at the steering column

checks: Ask whether an alignment or steering work was done recently
Run the steering angle sensor calibration with a scan tool
Check the sensor reading with the wheels straight
fix: Recalibrate the steering angle sensor; replace it if it still reads wrong.
